subject: Updated MAP + Pricing for ClearPath POC -> Ramp gating
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Susan White <susan.white@clearpath.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 15:09:00 -0700
Subject: MAP & pricing proposal for ClearPath PoC (first pass)

Hi Susan —

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Per our discussion I attached an initial MAP (Redwood_MAP_v2.xlsx) and a pricing proposal (Pricing_Proposal_ClearPath_v3.pdf). Key points:

- PoC (4 weeks): free evaluation credits + 5k tokens/day reserved for testing.
- Ramp stage (month 2–3): committed monthly units (CMUs) with a reduced per-token rate.
- Milestone gating:
  * MAP checkpoint 1 (PoC complete, acceptance test) -> unlock 10% committed discount on month-1 billing.
  * MAP checkpoint 2 (integration + performance sign-off) -> unlock additional 10% discount at agreed CMU level.
  * Final commit (12-month) -> additional volume discount tiers if commit > 1M tokens/mo.

I tried to keep the initial economics flexible: the current proposal shows a 20% maximum promotional discount tied to commits and MAP milestones; anything above that requires leadership approval.

Can you confirm the acceptance criteria you want for checkpoint 1 (functional vs performance) so we can lock the MAP? Also let me know if procurement needs a redline contract or SOW before we proceed.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0193

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v2.xlsx, Pricing_Proposal_ClearPath_v3.pdf
From: Susan White <susan.white@clearpath.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & pricing proposal for ClearPath PoC (first pass)

Karthik —

Thanks for the materials. High level looks good. A couple quick clarifications before we share with procurement:

1) For MAP checkpoint 1 we need a performance SLA for 95th percentile latency on our test set — can you confirm how you plan to measure and what tolerance we should expect?
2) On discounts: our CFO prefers a single blended discount rather than multi-stage if possible. What does the blended effective discount look like if we commit to a 6-month ramp to 500k tokens/mo?
3) Procurement will want a draft SOW and marked contract; can you send redlines?

Looping in Ben (ops) so he can flag any infra/region constraints.

—Susan
Susan White
Director of ML & Analytics, ClearPath Analytics
susan.white@clearpath.ai
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: MAP & pricing proposal for ClearPath PoC (questions from Susan)

Marissa / Sergio —

FYI: Susan asked three things (see below). I sketched answers inline and attached a revised pricing sheet with a blended view for a 6-month ramp to 500k tokens/mo. Highlights:

- SLA measurement: propose we run the Redwood MAP perf test harness (same test set) during PoC and report 95p latency. We can commit to 95p < 220ms on A100s for their seq lengths, with a clause that hardware/seq distribution adjustments will affect results.
- Blended discount: if they commit to 6 months with a 500k target, blended effective discount ≈ 18% across months 2–6 (I show month-by-month in the spreadsheet).
- Redlines: attaching a starting contract redline; legal will need to sign off but we can send a customer-facing draft to procurement.

Need your guidance: can we sign off on the 18% blended promo without exec sign-off, or do we need Marissa (pricing approval) to push to the deal desk? Also Sergio — any infra region caveats if they want multi-region in us-east + eu-west?

Thanks,
Karthik

Attachments: Pricing_Proposal_ClearPath_v3_blened_view.xlsx, Contract_Redlines_ClearPath.docx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 13:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: MAP & pricing proposal for ClearPath PoC (questions from Susan)

Karthik —

Thanks for the summary. Guidance below:

- SLA: the customer-facing SLA language in the SOW should be clear about test harness, dataset, and acceptable variance. We can commit to the 95p < 220ms target for the PoC stage as you suggested. Include an explicit clause that changes in model family or sequence-length distribution may affect latency and will be re-benchmarked.
- Pricing approval: we can approve up to a 20% effective promotional discount tied to MAP milestones at the AE level for deals < $250k ARR. For anything that results in >25% blended discount or >$250k ARR reduction, route to the deal desk (cc: pricing@redwood.com).
- Ramp/commits: require a minimum commitment schedule in the MAP (months and expected CMUs) and a termination clause if commitments are not met after the ramp window.

Sergio — confirm multi-region pricing delta and add note to the SOW about data residency.

Approve sending the blended 18% view to the customer. Please keep legal in the loop on the redlines.

Marissa
VP, Commercial Sales (Americas)
Redwood Inference
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: MAP & pricing proposal for ClearPath PoC (questions from Susan)

Karthik / Marissa —

Multi-region: we can support us-east + eu-west for the PoC and ramp, but there is a 6% price uplift for dual-region routing due to extra egress and reserved capacity. I'll add the language to the SOW and include a table in the pricing PDF showing single vs dual region costs. Also call out that data residency will be handled via our Private/VPC option if they need full isolation (separate contract).

Sergio
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Susan White <susan.white@clearpath.ai>, Ben Cohen <ben@clearpath.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, procurement@clearpath.ai
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 09:48:00 -0700
Subject: Updated proposal + MAP gating language (for procurement)

Susan / Ben —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Attached are: (1) Pricing_Proposal_ClearPath_v3.pdf (blended view for 6-month ramp), (2) Redwood_MAP_v2.xlsx (with explicit checkpoint acceptance criteria), and (3) a draft SOW for the PoC. Highlights:

- Checkpoint 1 (PoC acceptance): functional pass + perf test (95p < 220ms) using Redwood test harness. Passing checkpoint 1 unlocks a 10% committed discount that applies to the first month of billed usage after PoC.
- Checkpoint 2 (integration): additional 10% discount when integration is validated and throughput targets are met.
- Blended deal economics (6-month ramp to 500k tokens/mo) shown in the pricing PDF — effective promo ≈ 18%.
- Dual-region uplift: +6% if they opt for us-east + eu-west (not applied in the blended example).

Procurement: I included an initial redline (Contract_Redlines_ClearPath.docx) and the SOW. If procurement prefers we can send a single consolidated redline; otherwise we can provide a DocuSign link for the SOW and separate contract.

Requested next steps:
- Procurement: confirm required contract SLA language and turn-around for redlines.
- Susan: confirm acceptance criteria for checkpoint 1 (functional + perf ok?) and whether you want blended pricing or stage-based discounts.
- If OK, I’ll send DocuSign for the SOW and a HubSpot deal update with the MAP milestones.

Thanks,
Karthik

Attachments: Pricing_Proposal_ClearPath_v3.pdf, Redwood_MAP_v2.xlsx, SOW_PoC_ClearPath.pdf, Contract_Redlines_ClearPath.docx
From: Susan White <susan.white@clearpath.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Cohen <ben@clearpath.ai>, procurement@clearpath.ai
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Updated proposal + MAP gating language (for procurement)

Karthik —

Thanks — the team reviewed. Procurement asked for a few contract tweaks (liability cap language + invoice timing) — I attached their comments (sent separately). We like the blended approach and the 95p < 220ms target. Confirming our plan:

- PoC start: 2026-05-24
- PoC duration: 4 weeks; passing checkpoint 1 -> trigger 10% discount on month-1 billing after go-live
- Ramp: target 500k tokens/mo by month 6 with milestone reviews at month 2 and month 4

Ben will coordinate with procurement to get you a redline; expect to have procurement feedback by Wednesday. We are OK to proceed with the SOW DocuSign once the two contract items are resolved.

—Susan
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Susan White <susan.white@clearpath.ai>, Ben Cohen <ben@clearpath.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, procurement@clearpath.ai
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Updated proposal + MAP gating language (for procurement)

Susan / Ben —

Great — appreciate the quick confirmation. We'll stand up the PoC environment on 2026-05-24 and run the Redwood perf harness during week 3 to validate 95p latency. I’ll open a HubSpot task and attach the procurement redline when you send it.

I'll also prepare a DocuSign link for the SOW (holding on the two contract tweaks) and will not request signatures until procurement confirms the liability/invoice language.

Call to action: Ben — once procurement sends the redline, can you drop the file in this thread and I’ll route to legal for a quick review (P0). If anything looks like it would affect the MAP gating (e.g., changing acceptance language), flag it and we’ll pause the DocuSign.

Talk soon —
Karthik
